title: Run 80B AI Models on Your iPhone with Swiftlet
description: Swiftlet is a Swift and Metal runtime for running 35B and 80B Qwen MoE models on ordinary Apple devices including iPhones. It streams expert weights on demand from SSD storage to keep peak RAM usage under 4.5 GB. Swiftlet provides an open-source engine with CLI tool, local OpenAI-compatible server, and Swift library support.
